text.p: Typhoon Tina has top winds of 105 mph and is currently south of Japan, moving north northwest. Tina is expected to slowly weaken, passing west of Okinawa in about 36 hours, bringing a chance of heavy rain with some flooding, as well as wind damage. By 72 hours, Tina may threaten southern Korea with similar conditions, though there are some signs that the storm may turn more to the northwest. It will be a threat to shipping along its path as well.
Heavy rain and thunderstorms in Bangladesh the next few days may lead to further flooding resulting in crop and property damage.

In the USA Southwest and Rockies, thunderstorms have caused local flash flooding in portions of the region. During the next couple days, the heaviest storms will be in eastern Colorado into the plains of western Kansas, where flash flooding may occur.
